gtc.text: Nikya gathers the Zhur-Taa at the Speaking Mound and declares the right to claim bloodcrime on the Rakdos.
Kal secretly tracks the war-party on foot to protect Durri, and in the fight Nikya entangles a Rakdos ogre in vines.
A Rakdos bloodwitch then summons batlike demons from the earth, and the tide turns against the Gruul.
